programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Get ready for some fun outdoor escapades with Blippi! First, he visits a marina for an exciting kayaking adventure! After the kayaking, Blippi builds some sandcastles on the beach. Then, Blippi visits an outdoor children's museum, where he learns about boats, flowers and more! Blippi also learns about balancing weights when he weighs pine cones and climbs to the top of a cool lighthouse.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Get ready for an indoor bouncy bash with Blippi! First, he visits the Gravady indoor trampoline park in Las Vegas! As Blippi bounces around, we can learn about how different animals like frogs or kangaroos like to bounce, too! Then, join Blippi as he visits Boom Shaka, another indoor trampoline park! Bounce around with him as he tries some mid-air flips, tries his hand at rock climbing and so much more!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: It's time to learn the fundamentals with JJ! Join him and his friends as they practice their numbers by counting baby chicks with Grandpa and singing about five little monkeys jumping on the bed. Then, it's time to learn about colors! Watch as the kids paint plain toy cars with a splash of color and help Ms. Appleberry mix primary colors with jello to make secondary colors. From learning shapes to making yummy rainbow popsicles, this adventure is full of learning fun!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Go on a big animal adventure with JJ! The fun starts on Grandpa's farm, where JJ learns all about the animals and the sounds they make. He even helps give a sheep a bath! Then, it's time to head to the ocean. Join JJ and his family as they visit an aquarium and sing 'Baby Shark' with a real shark family! The adventure gets prehistoric when Ms. Appleberry teaches the class all about their favorite dinosaurs. From guessing games to meeting Bingo the dog, it's a wild day!

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Join Meekah for a fun day of caring for cute pets! First, she pretends to be a veterinarian at the Twinkle Play Space! She goes through Pettinville to visit all the animals in town, including a dragon, some cute birds and a lonely cow! Then, she is happily surprised to find a fun slide to play on! She visits with some cute cats, plays on a giant hamster wheel and then helps her new doggy friend get ready to meet his fur-ever family.

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Join Meekah as she gets creative with paint and cake! First, she visits the Paint Place in New York City, where she creates mixed media art inspired by the city skyline using materials like paint, foam and cotton balls. Then, Meekah puts on her baker's hat to decorate a friendship cake for Blippi! She learns about primary colors by mixing them to make secondary colors and cuts out different shapes to decorate her cake with.

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Join Blippi on an adventure to the wonders of our world and beyond! First, he travels to the tallest mountain on Earth, Mt. Everest, with his new friend Betty the Yeti. Then, he dives deep into the ocean to explore a kelp forest with Jerry the Jellyfish. The adventure gets explosive as Blippi and FETCH fly into a volcano! After exploring the Earth, Blippi blasts off into space to tour the solar system, learn about gravity on the moon and discover how rainbows get their amazing colors!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is your guide to having fun and healthy days! First, have some fun in the sun while learning from Señor Super Sunscreen how to apply sunscreen properly. Then, shrink down with Blippi and Meekah as they travel to Italy to learn how to make an authentic pizza! The adventure continues as Blippi helps a bear get ready for winter hibernation. After a long day of fun, it's time for bed, as a magical book reads a bedtime story about the benefits of a good night's rest!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is on an adventure from dinosaurs to pet knights! He travels back in time with Tabbs to help a little Microraptor prove that being small has its benefits when they rescue a giant sauropod from the mud. Then, they head to the African savannah to learn how to roar, sneak and pounce like a lion! Back at the clubhouse, Blippi learns how to interpret a puppy's tail wags and even travels back in time again to help a real-life knight in shining armor-who happens to be a corgi!

programme.title: Oddbods: Short
programme.desc: Oddbods follows the wacky adventures of seven unique and furry friends, who laugh, play and get up to mischief in their hometown of Oddsville, where even the most ordinary of situations have unexpected consequences.

The adventure continues at Nona Adventure Park where he learns about safety, colors and shapes while having a blast!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: It's time to learn all about animals with Blippi! First, he's at the Party Jungle indoor playground to learn about amazing animals like elephants, monkeys and more! Then, Blippi explores the Northwestern Trek, an amazing park in Washington! Blippi goes on an adventure around the park, teaching kids all about the native animals, from bald eagles to bears, mooses to elks and so much more!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: It's time to play JJ's favorite games! Join Ms. Appleberry and the Melon Patch kids as they play 'follow the leader' and have a contest to see who can make the silliest funny face. Then, JJ and his animal friends have a party where they play freeze dance! The fun continues with vehicles, as Grandpa makes a cool choo-choo train out of cardboard boxes and the kids play with different construction vehicles in a giant sandpit.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Join JJ for a guide to staying healthy and happy! The learning starts with hygiene, as JJ and his friends learn the importance of washing their hands and how to scrub-a-dub-dub in the bath. Then, it's time for some big milestones! Sing along as JJ learns to use the potty and TomTom learns what happens when you lose a tooth. Plus, join the Melon Patch kids as they visit the doctor for a checkup and learn that it's nothing to be afraid of!

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Get ready to get creative with colors and art with Meekah! First, Meekah's slime is in black and white! She searches the most colorful places to add color back to her gooey globs of slime. Can she find all the colors of the rainbow? Then, draw along with Meekah! She explores and plays on a real fire truck, learning about the different parts and noticing it has shapes and colors that she can draw to create her own firetruck!

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Join Meekah as she heads to Skyzone to explore the science of bouncing! First, she has a big question... how does someone do a flip? She gets some instruction from an amazing jumper, plays on the trampolines and even learns some numbers. Then, she's off on a solo adventure to answer the question, 'how does bouncing work?' She experiments with different kinds of balls to see which bounces best and even discovers the science behind trampolines!

programme.title: Air Asia Buds Adventures
programme.desc: It's time for a high-flying adventure with the Air Asia Buds! Join them as they explore a busy fire station, visit a fun-filled farm, and learn all about amazing animals. Their journey takes them to incredible destinations around the world, from the vibrant streets of Bangkok and the beautiful beaches of the Philippines to the bustling city of Kuala Lumpur. It's a non-stop trip full of fun, learning, and discovery.

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is on adventures big and small, from the mail to outer space! First, Blippi shrinks down to go inside the BlippiMobile's engine to fix a problem. Then, he follows a letter he wrote on its entire journey through the post office to Grandpa Blippi's mailbox! After that, he flies into outer space on a rocket, floating in zero gravity and performing a space walk. He even joins a boulder on its exciting trip down a river to become a grain of sand!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Join Blippi for some fun nature discoveries! First, he and D.BO dive to the ocean floor to help a forgetful island remember why it doesn't float away. Then, they shrink down for some smaller adventures! They help a firefly find a friend with the same blinking pattern, float high in the sky to learn how bubbles are made and join a group of ants on a mission to find out how they walk in such a straight line. The adventure is full of singing, science and new friends!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are making new friends and foes! First, Zee inadvertently picks up a piglet from a nearby farm and quickly forms a strong bond with his new friend. Then, Slick, with a little help from Bubbles, enters a 'Robot Wars' tournament! As he progresses through the rounds, his arrogance makes him an unlikely winner. Finally, Jeff discovers some unwanted nesting birds in his garden and a battle of wits begins!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: It's a strange day for the Oddbods! After being caught in one of Bubbles' experiments, Fuse and Newt accidentally switch bodies! As Bubbles searches for a way to reverse it, an over-excitable Fuse enters the now curmudgeonly Newt into a dance competition. Then, Slick goes on an increasingly desperate quest to find a 'Golden Ticket' for an exclusive disco-party. Plus, Slick is determined to look his best for the group photo.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi for a super fun day at an indoor playground called the Funtastic Playtorium! In this awesome play place, Blippi plays lots of different games and explores some huge tunnels. The fun doesn't stop there! He's back for more playtime as he shoots more balls out of a cannon, slides down a slide in lots of different silly positions and so many more fun things! It's a funtastic day of play!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Blippi goes on a scientific learning adventure! He heads to the Mount Wilson observatory to learn about all the cool things we can see in our night sky. From stars to moons to distant planets, learning about space is out-of-this-world cool! His journey continues at Wonderworks Science Museum when all of a sudden, oh no! The lights went out! So Blippi learns all about light and electricity. He goes through tunnels, plays both giant and regular pianos and even makes a shadow puppet show with his hands!

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Get ready for a big day of science experiments with Meekah! First, she visits the Glazer Children's Museum, where she plays a fun game of sink or float, serves customers in the play restaurants and builds a fort, all while counting! Then, Blippi and Meekah visit the Ontario Science Centre to learn about gravity and electricity. They build a rollercoaster, see water react to music and even see a Hot Air Balloon!

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Join Meekah for a land, sea and space extravaganza! First, she boards the Intrepid aircraft carrier for an air and sea adventure! She explores an airplane, a helicopter and learns about life as a sailor. Then, 3-2-1 Blast Off! Astronaut Meekah zooms around the Columbia Memorial Space Center. She builds a model of Apollo 11, watches a parachute sail to the ground, programs a Mars Rover and makes gooey slime for Blippi!

programme.title: TVP@TTV Pend. Islam Ting. 1 Ep03
programme.desc: Tajuk Makanan Halal Lagi Baik ini membincangkan tentang kita dituntut untuk mengambil makanan yang halal lagi baik. Untuk memperkembangkan lagi topik ini, murid diperjelaskan dengan maksud makanan halal dan makanan haram. Selain itu, topik ini juga menerangkan tentang akibat pengambilan makanan yang haram kepada rohani dan jasmani serta perbezaan ciri-ciri makanan halal dan makanan haram. Di samping itu, murid juga dapat menghuraikan pengajaran ayat berdasarkan Surah al-Baqarah ayat 168. Topik ini juga diakhiri dengan saranan aktiviti yang dapat murid lakukan di rumah sebagai amalan harian. Terdapat pentaksiran berbentuk formatif diberikan setelah selesai satu-satu sub-topik dibincangkan.

programme.title: TVP@TTV Pend. Islam Ting. 1 Ep02
programme.desc: Topik ini menerangkan tentang pengertian jahiliah. Diperincikan hal kejahilan dalam bidang akidah dan akhlak serta pelbagai pegangan akidah yang dianuti oleh masyarakat jahiliyah. Kejahilan masyarakat Arab ini masih wujud dan ada di antaranya masih diamalkan sehingga sekarang. Murid murid dikehendaki meninggalkan akhlak buruk yang terdapat dalam masyarakat sekarang yang mirip kejahilan masyarakat arab jahiliyah. Penerangan berkenaan sebab Rasulullah S.A.W diutuskan kepada kaum arab jahiliah ketika itu di mana ianya membawa kebaikan dan perubahan positif terhadap masyarakat pada ketika itu.

programme.title: Dukun
programme.desc: Lawyer, Karim, is searching for his missing child, Nadia. His desperation leads him to be entangled with an alleged murderer, Diana Dahlan. In the process of defending her, Karim learns uncomfortable secrets about his missing wife and child that may cause him to lose everything. A gory bloodfest that interweaves politics, greed, black magic, decapitation and dismemberment, and demon possesions, this horror film is loosely based on the real and gruesome murder of politician, Datuk Mazlan Idris, by Mona Fandey, a washed-up singer-turned-witch doctor who was convicted in 1993. Originally slated for release in 2007, its controversial subject matter forced the film into cold storage, until it was finally shown in 2018.

programme.title: The Free Fall
programme.desc: Sara discovers her mom stabbing her dad with a knife before slicing her own throat. After a failed suicide attempt, the traumatized young woman awakes from a coma with total memory loss, only to be greeted by her husband, Nick, whom she has no recollection of. She tries to piece together the events that led to her attempted suicide and to get accustomed to her new life, but reality grows murkier everyday until she is unsure what is real and what is not.

programme.title: Phone
programme.desc: Soon after getting a new phone, an investigative reporter named Ji-won begin receiving a series of disturbing calls. To escape the terrifying and relentless ringing of the phone, she changes her number and moves out to her sister's home. But the threatening campaign of terror continues, even as Ji-Won unravels the mystery behind the phone.

programme.title: The Room
programme.desc: Ron is a travelling salesman who is superstitious. Each time he stays in a new hotel room, he would perform all steps needed to avoid offending any spirits, such as knocking the door and politely greeting the room before entering it. He would also cover any mirror that faces the bed. Yet, when he returns from a late-night dinner, the room still feels eerily strange.

programme.title: I Wish I Wish aka Deseo Deseo
programme.desc: Five cousins reunite at the house of their recent deceased grandmother. As they rummage through her belongings, they discover a curious board game titled 'I Wish, I Wish (Deseo, Deseo).' Out of boredom, they decide to play the game together. The rules are simple: each player may ask 3 wishes that will be fulfilled after completing a challenge presented by the game. If they carry it out they will have what they desire; otherwise there are far reaching consequences. The players soon learn the game truly grants their wishes -- at a heavy cost. For those who have chosen not to fulfill the challenge, the game releases a vicious creature to enforces punishment on their loved ones. The group soon discover that they must keep playing, and risking others is the only way to save themselves.

programme.title: The Boy Behind The Door
programme.desc: After Bobby and his best friend Kevin are kidnapped and taken to a strange house in the middle of nowhere, Bobby manages to escape. But as he starts to make a break for it, he hears Kevin's screams for help and realizes he can't leave his friend behind.
